description: Creates or updates file sources, matched by ItemId, then by DisplayText within the same connector. The connector must be enabled on the site.

items.description: A file source: the connector it reads with, the AI data source it feeds and the connector's settings in Properties.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Source.description: The name of the ingestion connector, such as 'FileSystem', 'Ftp' or 'Sftp'.

DisplayText.description: The name of the file source.

AIDataSourceId.description: The id of the AI data source the files are indexed into. Import the data sources first.

ReindexIntervalMinutes.description: How often the files are read again, in minutes.

Properties.description: The connector's settings, such as the folder to read. Passwords and keys left out keep the stored ones.

Sources.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.
